# Written by the dashboard editor of Elamon (the web page and the app): dashboards and the
# tabs of profiles. A change by hand here is kept; elamond rewrites only the tables it is asked to.

[dashboards.mine]
title = "Mine"
icon = "gauge"

[[dashboards.mine.widgets]]
type = "gauge"
label = "CPU"
value = "cpu.usage"
max = 100
span = 2

[[dashboards.mine.widgets]]
type = "button"
label = "Lock"
action = "power.lock"
span = 2

[[dashboards.mine.widgets]]
type = "graph"
label = "Memory"
values = ["memory.used"]
format = "bytes"

mistakes.message: a dashboard has no key command (title, icon, role, for_each, widgets)
